gate: RTK C9 HMT lambda=1 round-S3 spatial FP nonzero-mode zeta magnitudes
scope: For the prospectively fixed spatial DeWitt/harmonic gauge and exact FP spectrum certified by the parent gate, freeze dimensionless positive-magnitude spectral operators for the transverse-vector and longitudinal-scalar-gradient nonzero sectors and compute their separate zeta-regularized determinant magnitudes. The six transverse l=1 Killing generators are spectrally primed out. This gate does not assign a Haar/group-volume normalization to those residual isometries, does not assign a signed/complex FP phase, does not multiply the spatial FP factors by the prior FS determinant or TT Hessian, and does not evaluate a one-loop effective action.

frozen_parent_operator.transverse_zero_modes: l=1 only, multiplicity 6, round-S3 Killing generators
frozen_parent_operator.longitudinal_eigenvalue: [4-l(l+2)]/a^2 on normalized vector modes proportional to nabla_i Y_l

frozen_positive_magnitude_spectra.transverse_operator: A_T=a^2 |M_T| on the primed transverse-vector domain
frozen_positive_magnitude_spectra.longitudinal_operator: A_L=a^2 |M_L| on the nontrivial longitudinal-vector domain
frozen_positive_magnitude_spectra.longitudinal_n_form: with n=l+1: n=2 gives lambda=1,d=4; n>=3 gives lambda_n^L=n^2-5,d_n^L=n^2
frozen_positive_magnitude_spectra.signed_FP_phase: not assigned in this gate; only determinant magnitudes of |M_T| and |M_L| are regularized
frozen_positive_magnitude_spectra.longitudinal_basis_semantics: The spectrum is that of M restricted to the longitudinal vector subspace using normalized vector eigenmodes. No extra scalar-gradient field-decomposition Jacobian is inserted into these operator determinants.

frozen_regularization.determinant_definition: Det_zeta(A_X)=exp[-zeta_X'(0)] for X=T,L provided the analytic continuation is regular at s=0
frozen_regularization.normalization: A_T=a^2|M_T| and A_L=a^2|M_L| are frozen independently; any rescaling c_X A_X must be tracked through Det_zeta(c_X A_X)=c_X^(zeta_X(0)) Det_zeta(A_X)
frozen_regularization.precedent: Use the already-certified C9 reduced-scalar zeta method: explicit binomial/Riemann-zeta analytic continuation, a direct convergent-domain spectral-sum cross-check, and high-precision truncation convergence.

required_checks: Construct explicit analytic continuations for zeta_T(s) and zeta_L(s) around s=0 from the frozen n-spectra; finite-cutoff products alone are not sufficient.
Verify both continuations are regular at s=0 and compute zeta_T(0), zeta_T'(0), zeta_L(0), and zeta_L'(0) with the frozen convergence tolerance.
Cross-check each continuation against its directly convergent original spectral sum at at least one Re(s)>3/2 value within the frozen absolute tolerance.
Compute finite positive Det_zeta(A_T) and Det_zeta(A_L) only if all regularity and convergence checks pass.
Verify the transverse spectral prime removes exactly six l=1 Killing zero modes and no additional transverse harmonic level.
Verify the longitudinal spectrum contains no zero mode and retains the l=1 longitudinal level with eigenvalue magnitude 1 and multiplicity 4; do not confuse it with the transverse Killing kernel.
Explicitly report normalization dependence sector by sector through the computed zeta_X(0); do not claim normalization independence unless that sector has zeta_X(0)=0.
Do not assign a signed/complex FP phase, a residual-isometry group volume, or a scalar-gradient decomposition Jacobian in this gate.

Do not multiply the two spatial FP magnitude factors by the prior scalar FS determinant or any TT Hessian factor, and do not claim a complete FP determinant, complete zero-mode measure quotient, HMT one-loop evaluability, or full C9 closure.
Do not import ordinary projectable-Horava beta functions, choose unresolved HMT matter coefficients, change thresholds, allow soft-s retest, unblock k=0.03 production, or mix DSIR.
pass_condition: Both frozen positive-magnitude spatial FP spectral zetas admit regular analytic continuation at s=0; convergent-domain cross-checks and derivative truncation checks satisfy the inherited tolerances; finite positive transverse and longitudinal zeta determinant magnitudes are obtained for the declared normalizations; exactly the six transverse l=1 Killing zero modes are primed out; and all signed-phase, group-volume, full-determinant, one-loop, and C9 claims remain open.
fail_condition: Either continuation is singular or fails convergence/cross-check tolerances, an unexpected zero mode appears or a required nonzero mode is omitted, the six-Killing spectral prime is misclassified, or any frozen semantic restriction is weakened.
